languages.hint: A shared language shows as a reason, never as a gap.

begin.title: Before we begin
begin.draftingNote: {name} will confirm this with the page.
begin.timelineRequired: Choose a timeline to continue; it shapes every folio.

done.title: Now write your page.
done.body: Your first folio arrives the evening after you publish it. Everything you just chose can be changed on the Looking for page.
done.bodyDrafting: Next, draft {name}'s page. Nothing is visible to anyone until {name} confirms it.

readers.title: Readers
readers.private: Only the candidate sees who read the page.
readers.incognitoNote: When this is on, the people whose pages you read aren't told. It's free, as a safety feature.
readers.empty: Nobody has read your page this week. Pages go out in folios each evening.

errors.generic: Something didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: You're not a member of this household.
errors.ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: Your role in the household doesn't allow this.
errors.CANDIDATE_ONLY: Only the person whose page it is can do this.
errors.PAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This page has been closed by its family.
errors.PAGE_AWAITING_CLAIM: The page is waiting to be confirmed.
errors.PAGE_EDIT_NOT_ALLOWED: You can read this page but not edit it.
errors.PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A few things are still needed before the page can be published.
errors.UNDER_18: A page can only be published for someone who is 18 or older.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address first; we sent you a link.
errors.LOOKING_FOR_INCOMPLETE: Finish what you're looking for first.
errors.VISIBILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: That visibility isn't available for this field.
errors.PHOTO_LIMIT: Five photos is the most a page holds.
errors.CLAIM_NOT_FOR_YOU: This invitation isn't for this account, or it has closed.
errors.ALREADY_CLAIMED: This page has already been confirmed.
errors.ALREADY_WROTE_TO_YOU: They've already written to you. Read their letter.
errors.LETTER_NOT_PENDING: This letter has already been answered.
errors.LETTER_WITHDRAWN: The note was taken back before you answered.
errors.SUGGESTION_UNEDITED: Make the line your own before sealing.
errors.CONTACT_IN_NOTE: Contact details open when you both say yes. Remove them to seal.
errors.NOT_A_FIT: Their page has a non-negotiable your page doesn't meet.
errors.INVALID_SLOTS: Choose three different half-hours in the next three weeks.
errors.NO_PHONE_ON_PAGE: Add a phone number to your page first.
errors.NO_FAMILY_CONTACT: Add a family contact to your page first.
errors.FAMILY_LINKS_NOT_ALLOWED: This family prefers their page isn't shared by link.
errors.FAMILY_LINK_LIMIT: You have the most family links open that your plan allows.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That's a lot at once. Try again in a minute.

claim.title: {drafter} has written a page for you.
claim.titleNoDrafter: Your family has written a page for you.
claim.lead: Nothing about you is visible to anyone until you confirm it. Read it as it stands; you can change anything before you publish.
claim.confirm: This is me: confirm my page
claim.afterConfirm: Confirming makes the page yours: only you can seal notes, say yes or close. {drafter} stays in the household as a guardian.
claim.declineDescription: The draft is deleted and {drafter} gets a kind note. No reason is needed.
claim.declinePlaceholder: Thank you for thinking of me. I'm not ready for this.
claim.declineFailed: That didn't go through. Try again.

states.verify: Verify your email address first, then open this page again. We've sent you a link.
states.claimed: This page has already been confirmed.
states.notYou: This invitation isn't for this account, or it has closed. If it was meant for you, sign in with the email it was sent to, or ask your family to send it again.
states.expired: This invitation has closed. Ask your family to send it again.

close.title: Close my search
close.lead: However it ends, Rishta closes kindly: nobody is left waiting and nobody is left guessing.

next.title: What happens next
next.hidden: Your page is hidden from every folio today.
next.breakLetters: Your letters and introductions stay open. You can resume in one tap.
next.waiting: {count, plural, one {# letter waiting for you gets a kind answer.} other {# letters waiting for you get a kind answer.}}
next.sealed: {count, plural, one {Your # sealed note is taken back.} other {Your # sealed notes are taken back.}}
next.introductions: {count, plural, one {Your # introduction receives your closing note.} other {Your # introductions receive your closing note.}}

close.closingNoteShort: A closing note is at least a short sentence.

confirm.title: Close your search?
confirm.body: Your page leaves every folio, open letters are answered kindly and your introductions receive your note. This can't be undone.
confirm.breakBody: Nobody new sees your page and no folios arrive. Your letters and introductions stay open.

delete.title: Delete everything?
delete.body: Your page, photos, letters, messages, readers and family links are deleted for good. After this you can also delete your account in Settings.

engaged.title: Congratulations.
engaged.body: We've closed your page kindly and let your open conversations know.

break.title: Your page is paused.
break.body: Take the time you need. Your letters and introductions are still here.

other.title: Your search is closed.
other.body: We've closed your page kindly and let your open conversations know. Thank you for the care you took.

story.question: Would you share how you met?
story.hint: Optional. It stays private unless you tell us otherwise.

close.referral: Know someone who's searching? Send them to rishta to begin a page.

credits.title: Credits & plan
credits.lead: Reading your folio and sealing three notes a day is free.
credits.familyNote: Credits and the plan are looked after by {name} and the household's guardians.
credits.checkoutFailed: Checkout didn't open. Try again in a moment.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.free: Free: 5 pages each evening, 3 notes a day.
plan.premium: Premium: 7 pages each evening, 10 notes a day.
plan.portalNote: Change or cancel your plan online at any time.

wallet.title: Credits
wallet.description: A credit is an extra note on a busy day, or a priority note, which is labelled for them and sits at the top of their letters for two days.

compare.title: Free and Premium
compare.freePrice: Free, for as long as you're searching.
compare.trial: Seven days free, then billed to the household. Safety features are always free.
compare.whatCreditsDo: The same service and prices for everyone.

single.title: A page
single.missing: This page isn't here. It may have been closed by its family.
single.private: {name} keeps the folio and its pages private for now.
single.error: The page didn't open. Check your connection and try again.

footer.safety: Rishta does not conduct criminal background checks on its members. The same service and prices apply to everyone.
